description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into five slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled as TriviaQA (red), WebQA (purple), HalluEval (green), an unlabeled category (yellow), and HalluQA (blue), with approximate proportions of 46%, 25%, 18%, 6%, and 5%, respectively. The chart includes percentage labels and numerical values outside the slices, with the unlabeled category having its label and value placed inside a gray box below the chart. The slices are visually distinct due to their colors, and the chart does not include a legend. The slices are not ordered in a specific sequence, but their sizes are arranged in descending order, with TriviaQA being the largest and HalluQA being the smallest.
